messages:
alex: Quick thread — saw a latency spike on prod batcher starting ~10:30 UTC yesterday. Traced to cases where runtime selects FlashAttention kernel while `paged_kv=true`. Results: batch formation stalls, token budget consumed by retries.

maya: Oh, interesting. Is this the same thing we saw in canary with long-prefix chats?

alex: Similar but different trigger. Repro locally with small harness: kernel selector prefers Flash for small-seq, but our KV pager introduces page faults that increase CUDA mutex wait. Stack trace:
```
[perf] kernel=flash_attn_forward time=2.3ms queuesz=12
[pagedkv] page_faults=7 kv_load_latency=9.8ms
[cuda_wait] mutex_wait=6.7ms
```

priya: Can you paste the batcher config? token budgets, queue_policy?

alex: config snippet:
```
batcher:
  mode: pipelined
  token_budget: 4096
  max_batch_time_ms: 8
  queue_policy: prefer_low_latency
kernel:
  preference: auto
  allow_flash: true
paged_kv: true
```

sam: Hmm token_budget 4096 might be too high for pipelined when paged_kv thrashes. It allows large batches that amplify page faults. Try 1024 as an experiment.

ci-bot: perf-regression-alert: job=flash-pagedkv-matrix build=7821 latency_p90 increased by 23% :eyes: 

maya: I ran a synthetic with token_budget=1024, kernel_preference='prefer_compat' (avoid flash if paged_kv true). Observed p95 down 18%.

alex: Nice. Plan: (1) add selector rule: if paged_kv=true then prefer paged-kv-compatible kernels (fall back to safe attention), (2) short-term reduce token_budget for pipelined on instances reporting page_faults>3, (3) add regression test in runtime CI that simulates paged_kv latency.

priya: I'll own #3 and wire up the harness. maya can you submit the selector patch?

maya: On it. Will open PR with benchmarks and flamegraph.

sam: I'll coordinate a small canary deploy after the PR merges, keep an eye on batch sizing telemetry.

alex: Tagging @maya @priya @sam — if anyone sees similar in other regions ping here. :thumbsup:
